ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Manifold differences names the many distinctions or divergent forms encountered at once.
EvidenceBody: Speakers place these differences under one phrase, one thread, one substance, or the action of being cut off.

Senses.Note: 8 exact witnesses from 8 independent works delimit this sense.
